# Paper sources (Overleaf-ready)

* `main.tex`: entry point (IEEEtran, conference mode). Compile with pdfLaTeX + BibTeX
  (Overleaf default). The diagrams in Fig. 1 (architecture) and Fig. 2 (alarm flowchart) are TikZ code
  inside `main.tex`.
* `references.bib`: bibliography; DOIs verified against Crossref on 2026-10-26.
* `IEEEtran.cls`, `IEEEtran.bst`: IEEEtran v1.8b from CTAN, included so the ZIP is self-contained.
* `figures/tradeoff.pdf`, `figures/replay22.pdf`: data figures (vector). They are regenerated by
  `figures/src/make_figs.py`, run from the project root, which reads `artifacts/benchmark/benchmark.json`
  and `artifacts/replay/22.json.gz`.
* `figures/src/alarm_state_machine.fprg`: Flowgorithm source of the alarm state machine shown in Fig. 2
  (written by hand, not yet opened in Flowgorithm).

All numbers come from `artifacts/benchmark/REPORT.md`, `artifacts/forecast/forecast.json` and the replay
files produced by the `windtwin` package (pipeline windtwin-2.0.0, CARE to Compare v6).
Before submission, fill in the author block (marked in `main.tex`).
